audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Levels 2, 3 and First item to Vayne and 4-5 / 6 to 'Skill', contradicting the packet chart (Skill, Maokai x5, Vayne), the 57.26% Emerald+ win rate over 124 games, and the whys[] text which describes Maokai winning every one of those stages.
audit.why: Maokai has W at 2 with a 14s cooldown and Sap Magic healing; Vayne pre-items has no way to stop a root she cannot see coming and loses the short trade. Only Level 1 (one ability vs Tumble) is neutral and only 2+ items is hers.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 through First item flipped to Maokai in both layers with ratings raised; 2+ items stays Vayne and drops to 3/10.

audit.why: Spike map is right: Maokai at 2-3, 6 and first item; Vayne at Final Hour and, decisively, 2-3 items where Silver Bolts percent-max-HP true damage beats any HP or armour you stacked.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is described only as 'Wall-stun. Don't get pinned' with no cooldown and no statement of the two interactions that decide the lane: Twisted Advance is untargetable while it travels, and Condemn only stuns when the knockback ends in terrain.
audit.why: Riot's text for Twisted Advance: Maokai is untargetable during the dash, so a Condemn fired at him after the cast cannot land on him and cannot stop the root. Riot's text for Condemn: the stun and bonus damage require collision with terrain, so fighting in open ground reduces it to a reposition. Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s.
audit.corrected: Both interactions and the 20s rank-1 cooldown written into tldr, phases[1].why, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.
sources: brief ownerKit W text + untargetable flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Vayne is referred to as 'his'/'he' throughout the trading and from-behind text.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun for the champion the page is about.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d, which is where it also let a real fact be added.
